dict.string: The Exocortex daemon runs your assistant's tools, which read and write files that belong to other apps.
The Exocortex daemon runs from and works on files in your Desktop folder.
The Exocortex daemon runs your assistant's tools, which work on files in your Documents folder.
The Exocortex daemon runs your assistant's tools, which work on files in your Downloads folder.
The Exocortex daemon runs your assistant's tools, which may work on files on removable volumes.
The Exocortex daemon runs your assistant's tools, which may work on files on network volumes.
The Exocortex daemon runs your assistant's tools, which may automate other apps.
